newsitem.title: USA: U.S. debt futures end lower after dull session.
newsitem.headline: U.S. debt futures end lower after dull session.

text.p: Feb 24 - U.S. debt futures finished the quiet session lower, stagnant ahead of supply and Humphrey-Hawkins testimony. Traders said near-term technical bias slightly lower going into Greenspan's Wednesday testimony to the Senate Banking committee. His testimony to the House has been postponed until March 5.
